config.invistags.title: InvisTags
config.invistags.showInvisibleSkin.toolt: Renders the body and skin of invisible players at full opacity.
config.invistags.showInvisibleNametag.to: Forces nametags above invisible players to render at full opacity, at any distance.
config.invistags.showInvisibleMobs.toolt: Renders invisible mobs at full opacity and shows nametags for custom-named invisible mobs.
config.invistags.rememberState.tooltip: Off by default. When off, skins, nametags and mob reveal always start disabled. Turn it on to keep the current toggles across restarts.
config.invistags.hint: Keys can be changed in Options > Controls > Key Binds. Mob reveal is config-only.
